name: Hydraulic Press #5001
technician_notes: Replaced damaged rubber seal. Re-pressurized hydraulic fluid loop to 250 Bar. Pressure steady after 4-hour stress test.

name: CNC Lathe #5002
technician_notes: Vibration sensor triggered automatic thermal shutdown at 85C. Installed new high-speed ceramic bearing set and thermal grease.

name: Robotic Arm #5003
technician_notes: Joint 3 positional accuracy dropped by 0.08mm. Replaced optical encoder and re-calibrated zero reference points.

name: 3D Metal Printer #5004
technician_notes: Laser wattage output dropped below 450W threshold due to smoke residue buildup on primary focusing mirror. Cleaned chamber & swapped optic module.

name: Laser Cutter #5005
technician_notes: Chiller temperature spiked to 28C triggering laser tube lockout. Fixed capillary tube leak, vacuum purged, and refilled coolant.

name: Injection Molding #5006
technician_notes: Zone 2 temperature controller reported open circuit alarm. Replaced burnt ceramic wire terminals and mica heater band.

name: AGV Transport #5007
technician_notes: Vehicle stopped unexpectedly along aisle 4 corridor. Swapped scratched front optical window and updated map calibration.

name: Conveyor Belt System #5008
technician_notes: Belt slack caused box congestion at sorting hub. Re-tensioned motor mount alignment and replaced worn drive belts.
